svg.title: HyperWeave
svg.desc: HyperWeave favicon — octahedral silhouette reduced to a 32-unit grid: diamond ring, tinted field, solid transmitter core. Adapts to the host colour scheme.

hw:selection-signal.reason: Eli, reviewing the ten-form specimen sheet: B and C named favourites, then E, then I. Rejected the filled-core forms (A, J) as centre-heavy.
Eli, reviewing the ten-form specimen sheet: B and C named favourites, then E, then I. Rejected the filled-core forms (A, J) as centre-heavy.

hw:reasoning.hw:intent: One file for every context where the mark is smaller than the type around it: browser tab, inline markdown badge, Slack emoji, list bullet.
hw:reasoning.hw:approach: Redrawn, not downscaled. The full glyph has five layers of stroke and glass that fuse into a smudge below 32px, so the micro form keeps only what survives: the diamond ring at 2.4 units, a 10% field tint that gives the silhouette body without a third edge, and the transmitter kept as a concentric second ring at 0.155 of local scale with the singularity as a 1.6-unit point. Every coordinate is snapped to the 32-unit grid so the ring lands on whole device pixels at 16 and 32. Colour is a single ink per file — gradients dither at this size — driven here by a custom property so one file serves both schemes.
hw:reasoning.hw:tradeoffs: Selected as form C from a ten-form specimen sheet: the filled-core forms (A, J) put the mass at the centre, turning the outer diamond into a frame around a slab. Cost of the concentric answer is that at 16px the two rings sit two pixels apart and can moire on non-integer scaling — pinned to the 32-unit grid to keep them on whole pixels at 16 and 32. Dropped the four vertex beads for the same reason — round line joins already carry the vertices, and discrete beads at 16px alias into fuzz. Dropped the pulse: a favicon animating in a browser tab is a distraction, and Safari ignores it regardless. Kept the field tint even though it is nearly invisible on dark hosts, so the light-host form is not a different drawing.
hw:reasoning.hw:spatial-notes: 32x32 grid, radial symmetry about (16,16). Diamond vertices at 2.6 and 29.4 leaving 2.6 units of clearance for the stroke miter; ring stroke 2.4 with round joins. Transmitter ring spans 18.6 units across at 0.155 local scale — 59% of the diamond width — stroked at 2 units against the outer ring's 2.4, so the two edges read as concentric rather than as frame-and-fill. Singularity r=1.6. Field tint 10%.
